entries.final_answer: Reachability-based, message-only. Source lanes where planned is structurally unreachable (blocked, canceled, done) get a legal-targets refusal naming their real recovery (blocked -> resume via --to in_progress or cancel via --to canceled; canceled/done -> terminal, no targets). Review-family lanes where planned IS reachable (in_review, in_progress, approved, genesis) keep the existing review-feedback guidance. FSM allow/deny is untouched; the guard stays unconditional and force-proof. Operator confirmed blocked->in_progress is the intended one-hop resume and declined expanding scope to legalize blocked->planned.
entries.question: How broadly should the source-aware refusal message apply: only the blocked source lane, or every lane where planned is structurally unreachable?
